product.name: Watt rotative beam engine, simplified (1788 type)

frame: x from the boiler towards the flywheel, y across the engine with the flywheel on the negative side, z up with z = 0 on the floor; mm, the frame of modules/cad/steam_engine.py. Bed frame top at z 300, cylinder axis at x 600, beam pivot at x 3100, z 4000, crankshaft at x 5600, z 2100, flywheel diameter 3500 centred at y -900, boiler from x -3000 to -1200; overall x -3000 to 7350, beam top at z 4250.

extended.interpretationNote: Valve chest and cylinder cover omitted: one steam port on the side wall at z 2150 and one eduction port at z 500; base flange 800 mm across.
Drawn at mid-stroke; the packing is not modelled.
Runs through the cylinder gland, which belongs to the cylinder casting.
Parallel-sided box section with a 200 mm gudgeon; the original beam tapers towards its ends.
Two plummer blocks on the entablature, base and cap each; the cap bolts are not drawn.

Two link sets at y +/-150 straddling the beam; the radius rods end at x 2500 where a column bracket would carry their fixed pivot. The single-acting engine uses an arch head and chain instead, which this dataset does not hold.
Drawn at mid-stroke from the beam end to the crank pin.
Web and pin; keyed to the flywheel shaft end at y 100.
Dichtung des Zylinderdeckels. Zukaufteil; die STEP-Datei ist nur ein Hüllkörper und nicht die Herstellergeometrie.
Wagon boiler simplified to a cylindrical barrel with a steam dome; setting, firebox and chimney not modelled; pressure class PN 6.
Throttle on the steam dome; the lever at z 2300 takes the governor link.
Straight run at z 2150 from the throttle outlet to the cylinder port, flanged at both ends.
From the cylinder bottom port to the condenser at z 500, flanged at both ends.
Separate condenser without its cold-water cistern; the injection cock is not modelled.
The pump rod rises to the beam at x 2200; foot valve and bucket are not modelled.
Junta del vástago de la válvula de regulación. Artículo de compra; el fichero STEP es sólo un sólido envolvente y no la geometría del fabricante.

attributes.compound: EPDM 70 Shore A, resistente al vapor

extended.interpretationNote: Rim, hub and eight round spokes; the original wheel has a rim cast in segments.
Plain shaft keyed to the flywheel and to the crank web at its y 100 end.
Stands on the bed frame at the boiler end; the belt drive from the flywheel shaft to the pulley at z 600 is not drawn; the link rod to the throttle lever is one body of this part.
Modern replica Bourdon gauge on a siphon stem screwed into the boiler shell; mechanical, no electrical connection.
Authored modern addition and the only electrical item: a tachometer display on a post bolted to the governor base plate, fed by M12 sensor plugs on the governor.
Seal of the governor spindle gland at the throttle linkage. Purchased item; the STEP file is only an envelope solid and not the manufacturer's geometry.
One ribbed bedplate drawn as a slab; the boiler stands beyond it on its own setting.
Hollow column at y +700; left is positive y, seen from the boiler towards the flywheel.
Hollow column at y -700, on the flywheel side.
Carries the beam bearing blocks and the nameplate; its bolts to the column caps are not modelled.

parts.name: Chaises de palier de l'arbre de volant

extended.interpretationNote: Two plummer blocks, outboard of the flywheel and between flywheel and crank, base and cap each.
On the entablature face at y -900.

proposedDefects.notExpressibleBecause: needs a same-site dependency relation the model does not carry: the piston rod runs through the gland of the cylinder casting, a dependency between two parts of the DE site; an external reference links two sites and the site's bill of materials does not hold this relation, so lifecycleConflict cannot report it
proposedDefects.detail: Kolbenstange D-33003 is Freigegeben (RELEASED) while Dampfzylinder D-33001, through whose gland it runs, is In Arbeit (WORKING)
proposedDefects.needs: a lifecycle column in each PLM part table (DE status, FR etat, ES estado, UK lifecycle) mapped by R2RML to a canonical atelier:lifecycle (WORKING, RELEASED, BLOCKED, SUPERSEDED; UK Frozen mapped to BLOCKED), and a SHACL shape failing a RELEASED part whose mate or BOM neighbour is WORKING

proposedDefects.detail: the bed frame's external reference names the equilibrium valve, a part of the single-acting variant only
proposedDefects.needs: product variants in the core database (variant, variant_part) and external-reference rows in the PLMs (remote URN, quantity, expected revision), an atelier:inVariant mapping, and a shape failing a reference whose target shares no variant with the referencing part
